Continent.fact: A continent is any of several large terrestrial geographical regions.  Continents are generally identified by convention rather than any strict criteria.  A continent could be a single large landmass, a landmass and nearby islands either on or beyond its continental shelf, or a part of a larger landmass, as in the case of Asia and Europe within Eurasia.
